title: castanopsis sieboldii subsp. lutchuensis
intro: Castanopsis sieboldii subsp. lutchuensis, commonly known as Japanese chinquapin, is a plant species belonging to the family Fagaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Castanopsis sieboldii subsp. lutchuensis include wound healing, antidiabetic, and cardiovascular protection.
